summary: Static code review of v60.1.221 DOM-order fix across 3 extension modules (Fase 1/2/3). Traced insertion-anchor logic for all 6 async race orderings. Fix is CORRECT when no campaign exists (all 6 orderings produce desired order Over → Filters → Collecties → Grid). Fix has a RACE-CONDITION BUG when a campaign exists AND Fase 3 resolves before Fase 1: in 3 of 6 orderings the .pp-bp-camp block lands BEFORE .pp-bp-over instead of after it.

ui_bugs.issue: Anchor priority list is ['.pp-bp-filters', '.pp-bp-collecties', '.pp-bp-camp', '.bp-prod-grid']. When Fase 3 inserts .pp-bp-camp BEFORE Fase 1 runs (async race: Firestore resolves before Fase 1 render), camp lands just after Stats via Fase 3's fallback path (`over ? after over : BEFORE filters/grid`). Fase 1 then finds .pp-bp-filters or .pp-bp-collecties first and inserts Over BEFORE that anchor — but AFTER the already-placed camp. Result: Stats → Camp → Over → Filters → Coll → Grid (WRONG; desired Stats → Over → Camp → Filters → Coll → Grid).

In race ordering 3→1→2 the filter-bar can land AFTER camp but BEFORE .pp-bp-over (which was inserted between camp and coll by a mis-anchored Fase 1). Result: Stats → Camp → Filters → Over → Coll → Grid. This is a downstream symptom of the Fase 1 candidate-order issue above; fixing Fase 1's candidate list resolves it.

integration_issues.flow: Merkenprofiel initial render with campaign active
integration_issues.issue: Order violation depends on which Firestore promise resolves first (Fase 2 products query vs Fase 3 campagne/collecties queries) relative to Fase 1's synchronous render. In practice Fase 1 (sync) usually wins the race, but network/cache variability can still trigger the bug (e.g., Firestore SDK cache-hit resolves microtask-fast).

action_items: In /app/pwa/extensions/brand/pp-brand-profile-v1.js line 511, reorder Fase 1 anchor candidates to put .pp-bp-camp FIRST: `var candidates = ['.pp-bp-camp', '.pp-bp-filters', '.pp-bp-collecties', '.bp-prod-grid'];` — this guarantees Over is always inserted BEFORE camp regardless of async ordering. All 6 orderings then produce the desired DOM (Over → Camp → Filters → Coll → Grid).

Alternative/defensive fix: after each Fase inserts a block, add a small `normalizeOrder()` post-pass that re-parents nodes into the canonical order using explicit DOM position checks. This is more robust against future additions but bigger change.

Optional: keep sync/async guarantee explicit — since Fase 1 is synchronous, ensure Fase 1 is `import`ed/loaded BEFORE Fase 3 in the HTML, so Fase 3's Firestore fetch cannot start until after Fase 1 has already inserted .pp-bp-over. Combined with the candidate-order fix, this makes the race practically impossible.
critical_code_review_comments: Fase 1 anchor priority [filters, collecties, camp, grid] is incorrect: .pp-bp-camp should have HIGHEST priority so Over is inserted before camp when camp is already present. Current order treats camp as low-priority anchor, which breaks the race case.

Fase 3 camp insertion has a hardcoded assumption that .pp-bp-over is present. The `else` branch (`BEFORE filters/grid`) places camp too high in the DOM (just after Stats), which is the trigger for the race bug.
The 3 extension files correctly respect the additive-only constraint: they only READ legacy anchors (.bp-page, .bp-prod-grid) and insert sibling nodes; no legacy element is mutated/removed. ✅
All insertion helpers correctly guard against null parentNode. ✅
Node syntax check: files parse cleanly (pre-verified by main agent). ✅
No hardcoded URLs/env leaks in extension files. ✅

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: Fase 1's anchor-candidate list at /app/pwa/extensions/brand/pp-brand-profile-v1.js:511 lists '.pp-bp-camp' as 3rd priority (after filters and collecties). When Fase 3's Firestore promise for the campagne resolves BEFORE Fase 1's synchronous render (e.g., due to Firestore cache-hit or JS module load order), .pp-bp-camp is inserted into the DOM via Fase 3's fallback branch (fase3 line 189-193: `over? insertBefore(el, over.nextSibling) : insertBefore(el, filters||grid)`), landing between Stats and Grid. Fase 1 then runs and its candidate lookup returns .pp-bp-filters or .pp-bp-collecties (if already placed by Fase 2/3) BEFORE it would ever match .pp-bp-camp, so Over is inserted before those anchors — but AFTER the pre-placed camp. Final DOM: Stats → Camp → Over → Filters → Coll → Grid, violating desired Stats → Over → Camp → Filters → Coll → Grid. REPRODUCTION: Load merkenprofiel with a brand that has an active campagne while the Firestore SDK has cached the campagne doc (subsequent visits after first load). MITIGATION: reorder Fase 1 candidates array to `['.pp-bp-camp', '.pp-bp-filters', '.pp-bp-collecties', '.bp-prod-grid']` — 1-line change, no other impact. All 6 async orderings then produce the correct DOM order.
